description:
You are a Database Developer at a music streaming startup. The engineering team needs a Physical Entity-Relationship Diagram (ERD) for the Chinook database before migration to a new cloud data warehouse. The SQL schema file is on your Desktop at ~/Desktop/chinook_schema.sql.

Create a complete Physical ERD in draw.io that documents ALL 11 tables in the schema: Artist, Album, Track, MediaType, Genre, Playlist, PlaylistTrack, Invoice, InvoiceLine, Customer, and Employee. Each entity box must show the table's columns with PK and FK indicators. Draw relationship lines between tables that share foreign key relationships, using crow's foot notation to show cardinality (e.g., one-to-many). Organize the entities into at least 3 logical subject-area groups (e.g., Media Catalog, Sales/Invoicing, People/HR). Add a second diagram page titled 'Relationship Summary' listing each FK relationship as text.

Save the diagram as ~/Desktop/chinook_erd.drawio and export a PNG copy as ~/Desktop/chinook_erd.png.
